διαλλάσσω: to change one with another, interchange, reconcile
διαπράσσω: to pass over; bring about, accomplish
εἰσφέρω: to bring in, to propose (a question, a law), to pay tax (εἰσφορά)
εὔχομαι: to pray, offer prayers, pay one’s vows, make a vow
κατάγνυμι: to break in pieces, shatter, shiver, crack
καταλέγω: recount, tell at length and in order; enrol, enlist
καταπήγνυμι: to stick fast in the ground, plant firmly
κατατάσσω: to draw up in order, arrange
κατατήκω: to melt away, to make to fall away
καταψήχω: to rub down, pound in a mortar
κηρύσσω: to be a herald, officiate as herald
λέγω: to say, tell, speak; epic and arch.: pick, gather
λαγχάνω: to obtain by lot, by fate, by the will of the gods
παραλέγω: talk nonsense/beside the point; pluck out hair; sail along a coast
παρατάσσω: to place side by side, draw up in battle-order
πλέκω: to plait, twine, twist, weave, braid
προδοκέω: seem good beforehand, be resolved beforehand
στηρίζω: to make fast, prop, fix, set
συγκαταζεύγνυμι: to yoke together, join in marriage
συνάγω: to bring together, gather together, collect, convene
συνταράσσω: to throw all together into confusion, to confound, disturb, trouble
τεύχω: to make ready, make, build, work
φεύγω: to flee, take flight, run away
φυλάσσω: to keep watch and ward, keep guard
ἀίσσω: to move with a quick shooting motion, to shoot, dart, glance
ἀλλάσσω: to make other than it is, to change, alter
ἀνάγω: to lead up; mid. set sail
ἀντιτάσσω: to set opposite to, range in battle against
ἀπείργω: to keep away from, debar from
ἄρχω: (to be first) to rule, to begin
ἐκκηρύσσω: to proclaim by voice of herald
ἐκπλήσσω: (to knock out); to astound, shock, amaze
ἐκπράσσω: to do completely, to bring about, achieve
ἐνζεύγνυμι: to yoke in, bind, involve in
ἐπεισάγω: to bring in besides, to bring in
ἐπιτάσσω: to put upon one as a duty, to enjoin
ἔοικα: to be like; to look like
ἱκνέομαι: to come, reach, approach; to supplicate, beseech; to befit
